wiki.title: Alexandra Macedo
wiki.extract: Alexandra Marie Macedo (born 1994) is an American politician who is a member of the California State Assembly for the 33rd district, a largely rural district based in the San Joaquin Valley. She has served as Assembly Republican Leader since August 3, 2026.
